cards.title: Pseudoscalar dipole-dipole interaction

checks.reason: The complete tensor potential is printed in Eq. (1).
For transverse spins and separation the anisotropic projection vanishes, leaving (m/r^2+1/r^3)exp(-mr).
In natural units the mass/r^2 and 1/r^3 terms divided by m_n^2 have energy dimension.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the transverse Yukawa kernel directly and by finite-volume quadrature when cell geometry is supplied.
open_questions: Cell dimensions and finite-volume layout are only in inaccessible Supplemental Material.

cards.title: Rotating free-decay source field

checks.reason: Eq. (2) prints the rotating exponentially decaying source field.
The transverse magnitude starts at |Bp|N* and vanishes exponentially.

cards.numerical_form: Generate orthogonal quadratures on a declared time grid.

cards.title: Noble-gas transfer function

checks.reason: The Lorentzian response and quadrature matrix are printed in Eq. (3).
The scalar gain equals eta on resonance and rolls off as inverse detuning.
The printed operating point is nuI=5.360 Hz, TI*=7.63 s, eta about 145.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the transfer matrix in frequency space and an equivalent causal complex-envelope ODE.
open_questions: The supplement contains additional drive examples and calibration details.

cards.title: Resonant free-decay sensor response

checks.reason: The complete closed response is printed in Eq. (4).
The response is zero at t=0 and decays to zero at late time.
The TI*=TII* removable limit is proportional to t exp(-t/TI*).

cards.numerical_form: Use a stable expm1-based expression near equal coherence times.

cards.title: Magnetic amplification factor

checks.reason: The paper prints the formula and kappa0=493+/-31.
The independently used measured result eta about 145 is retained as a paper parameter, not inferred from pixels.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate eta when M, polarization and gyromagnetic ratio are supplied; use the measured eta for main-text reproduction.
open_questions: The main text does not print all factors needed to recompute eta from first principles.

cards.title: PSD-weighted optimal template filter

source_refs.value: Main Eq. (5) and preceding definition, page 4

checks.reason: The filter and inverse transform are printed in Eq. (5).
Choose alpha so a unit-amplitude injected template is recovered with unit peak.
Direct weighted least squares and FFT correlation are algebraically equivalent and will be cross-checked.

cards.numerical_form: FFT correlation with an explicit one-sided PSD and a direct weighted least-squares parity path.
open_questions: The measured PSD and raw 60-second records are unpublished.

cards.title: Independent-error combination

checks.reason: The paper states that independent systematic factors are combined in quadrature.
140 aT statistical and 45 aT systematic uncertainties give 147.06 aT total.

cards.numerical_form: Combine declared independent components and preserve separate statistical/systematic outputs.
open_questions: Individual systematic components are in inaccessible Supplemental Material.
